tags.balance_change: Changed Lan’s mid-late Glades weapons to be slightly stronger.
Augments in Oasis have slightly less SP costs early and slightly more SP costs late.
Characters no longer start with 25% of their Levels Gained as Stat Points. They now start with 1 Stat Point in Glades and 0 Stat Points in Oasis.
Characters now get a diminishing number of extra Stat Points, this amount scales with the Levels Gained value for that Story.

tags.bug: Cloud Saves are now always loadable.
Runs that are started with less than 0 Encounter Points allow for you to change Equipment instead of instantly ending the Run.
Oasis can no longer be started if you have less than 2 Encounter Points from incoming runs.
Incoming runs from Glades no longer duplicate if you press the override button.

tags.balance_change: EXP and Gold Area Bonuses are now actually multiplicative. Gold Bonuses have been halved to compensate.

tags.bug: The run no longer ends when talking to Lyra for the first time as Sibyl.
Stan no longer remains after his dialogue with Apolonia in the Glades.
Equipment Slots in the Equipment Shop no longer have a plus if you are not in the right Zone.
Sibyl can now equip more than one Twilight Amulet as an Accessory even when she has one non-accessory Twilight Amulet equipped.
All of Sibyl’s loot is now obtainable.
Sibyl’s Special Move shows the correct values during Ascended.
Sibyl can no longer move with the Stats Menu open after she uses her Special.
The cliff in the Level 6000 Area in Sibyl’s Glades Story now has a proper hitbox.
Text from the previous Encounter no longer shows up in the next Encounter if you start an Encounter very quickly after ending the previous Encounter.
The first formula in Dodge’s Codex is now correct.

notes.title: Oasis Update
notes.content:
[h1]Content:[/h1]
[list]
[*] New Zone: Oasis!
[/list]
[h1]Features:[/h1]
[h3]Stats Page:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Edit your Equipment and Loadouts without having to enter a run.
[/list]
[h3]Codex:[/h3]
[list]
[*] View detailed explanations on how the game calculates various stats.
[/list]
[h3]UI Redesign:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Should be much faster to navigate through.
[/list]
[h3]Balance Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Agility and Luck should be significantly more useful.
[*] Damage Dealt: 100% Attack -> 100% Attack + 50% Agility
[*] The Gold Multiplier scales much better with Luck.
[*] New Luck based “Clutch Power” mechanic.
[*] When a Character is low HP, they have a higher chance of comboing, critting, or dodging. The amount that this chance increases is now based on Luck.
[*] Achievements are more difficult, but less SP is required to upgrade Augments.
[*] Before, you got more than enough SP without thinking much about it. Now, achievement runs will meaningfully help progression as there isn’t enough SP otherwise.
[*] Swapping Equipment allows for a small bit of movement if the swapping would instantly start an Encounter.
[*] Gives a maximum of 5 Distance.
[*] Many various changes to Equipment and Augments to better suit the new stat system.
[/list]
[h3]Ascended Mode:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Extra Stat Points are provided once your Character is above the Story’s Max Level.
[/list]
[h3]Minor Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Too many to count. If you find something that used to be better or is now not working let me know. 
[/list]

[*] View detailed explanations on how the game calculates various stats.
[*] Should be much faster to navigate through.

[*] Swapping Equipment allows for a small bit of movement if the swapping would instantly start an Encounter.
[*] Many various changes to Equipment and Augments to better suit the new stat system.

notes.title: A.4.1
notes.content:
New Features:
[list]
[*] Tapping an Allocation button on the Allocation menu while another finger is touching the screen now decreases the Allocation ratio. 
[*] Touchscreen devices now have a setting to move with a joystick.
[*] There is now a setting to show a linear health bar for the enemies.
[*] There is now a hotkey for using your Special Move (“Q”).
[*] You can now prepare your special move to be used instantly in the next Encounter by clicking the “Special Move status bar” in the top left. The Special Move hotkey also works for this function.
[*] There are now Allocation Loadouts.
[*] Has hotkeys for swapping between Allocation Loadouts (Shift + 1/2/3/4/5)
[*] There are now hotkeys for opening menus:
[*] Stat Allocation Menu: “R”
[*] Equipment Shop: “F”
[*] Achievement Menu: “T”
[*] Bestiary: “G”
[*] Settings: “Z”
[/list]
Balance Changes:
[list]
[*] Your damage increases multiplicatively instead of additively every turn. If you aren’t using Stan’s Devastating Strikes or critting, this does nothing. Otherwise, this lowers your damage before turn 5, is equivalent at turn 5, and increases your damage past turn 5. Same scaling per turn (starts at 0.75x, and increases by 0.05x per turn), but now maxes out at 1.25x. This means past a certain turn count (the exact turn number depends on the strength of your Devastating Strike/crit) this change is a nerf.
[*] Lowered Apolonia’s final level BP cost for Weapon Mastery, Magical Imbuement, and Holy Power by 1.
[*] Lowered Apolonia’s BP costs for Levels 2 - 5 of her Special Move by 1.
[*] Lan’s Special Move duration nerfed at all Levels.
[/list]
Minor Changes (Lan):
[list]
[*] Belts can now be dropped as loot for Lan.
[*] Loot no longer drops for Lan unless he has unlocked the Equipment menu by talking to Lyra.
[*] Common Barb is now dropped by Crab Emperor.
[*] Thanks to Vanderwaal for finding this.
[*] Fixed the overlay hitbox for Lan’s Level 2222 Area.
[*] The transition from land to water in Hunting for Truth from the Level 250 Area to the level 700 Area is now more clear.
[*] One of Lan’s Level 360 Area is now visible from the Level 250 Area in Hunting for Truth.
[*] Now shows the correct value for Lan’s max equipment from Glades.
[*] No longer shows the first frame of Lan’s hit animation at the start of the first Encounter on a newly opened instance of the game.
[*] Lan’s Special Move bar now animates during his Special Move dialogue.
[/list]
Minor Changes (Ascended):
[list]
[*] Ascended now accurately shows your progress based multiplier as 25% per category and shows 125% as the max bonus.
[*] Ascended’s Permadeath renamed to Hardcore.
[*] Ascended will now show an Area’s overlay and its Area Level/Area Bonus if you have defeated every enemy within that Area. Still does not show Area Levels/Area Bonus’ if you are on Hardcore.
[*] Added the text “(can only change if you have not finished a run)” to the Hardcore option’s description.
[*] The Bestiary now shows all Areas that have a lower or equal Level to the highest Level Boss that you have defeated.
[*] There are now hotkeys for Equipment Loadouts and Allocation Loadouts using the numpad.
[*] Saves are now partially backwards compatible. You will still lose data on new content, but your old progress will no longer be deleted. Do not play an old version of the game without backups of your save!
[*] Encounter Distance now updates differently when changing Equipment. Can no longer display over 100% Encounter Chance.
[*] The victory dialogue animation no longer flashes text that overlaps an obstacle.
[*] The Stat Allocation pop up now disappears correctly after resetting a run while it is animating.
[*] The dialogue speed setting text now immediately shows the correct speed if changed.
[*] Can no longer start an Encounter by using a hotkey or the start Encounter button in the top left when you have less than 1 Encounter Point.
[*] Can no longer swap Equipment loadouts to an Equipment loadout with more Encounter Points in the game over screen, reset the game, and continue where you left off.
[*] Updated the loadout explanation dialogue to include a description of the Stat Allocation loadouts.
[*] The reset run button on the timer now makes a hover/click sound.
[*] 6 Typos.
[/list]
